title: Dependency advisories in the framework lockfile: zod below 4.6.6 (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5) blocks every consumer's fix; `pnpm audit --prod` on the pin reads 5 critical and 10 high
body:
Filing gate ①: class (a), a named producer measured by a consumer. Found by the cloud os-dev on objectstack-ai/cloud#3189 (report comment `6383664909`, PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3211). Filed by `repo:cloud#1` (seat post #6026, session `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack lane that owns the workspace's dependency ranges and lockfile. objectstack-ai/cloud#3189's remaining half is `Blocked-by:` this card.

## Measured
- **zod, which blocks cloud.**
  - The framework's lockfile, at cloud's pin `f0fdd45bbc83` and on `main`, resolves `zod` 4.6.1 and 4.6.5. Both are below the fix for GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (memory exhaustion on oversized collections; patched ≥4.6.6).
  - When cloud moves its own control-plane packages to zod ^4.6.6 (resolving 4.6.7), `pnpm build` fails in its `tenant-router` DTS: cloud's zod 4.6.7 types are not assignable to the pinned framework's zod 4.6.5 types. zod 4.6.6 changed `v4/core` `schemas.d.ts` (`$ZodRecordInternals`) and `util.d.ts`.
  - So no consumer can take the zod fix until the framework does. Casting at the boundary would hide the mismatch on the consumer side.
- **The framework's own audit.** `pnpm audit --prod` on the pinned tree exits 1, with 5 critical and 10 high. The modules named:
  - `next` 16.3.8 (RCE; patched ≥16.4.1);
  - `dompurify` ≤3.4.16;
  - `body-parser` <2.4.0;
  - `happy-dom` ≤21.0.3;
  - `postal-mime` <4.0.8;
  - `@azure/msal-node` <7.1.0;
  - `undici` 8.11.2 (<8.12.2);
  - `zod`.

  These are public advisories in published dependencies. Re-measure on `main` for the exact paths.

## Wanted
- The workspace resolves one `zod` ≥4.6.6. Every package that declares zod moves its range, and the lockfile is regenerated by pnpm.
- The other high and critical advisories are cleared the same way, by moving each package to its lowest patched release. Any that cannot move (a major break) are listed with the reason.
- ⛔ No new CI gate unless the maintainer names one.

## Acceptance
- `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high` exits 0 on `main`, or every remaining entry is listed with its reason.
- `pnpm build`, typecheck and the test tiers stay green.
- Cloud then raises its five control-plane zod ranges with a pin bump, and its audit reads 0 (objectstack-ai/cloud#3189).

## Dedupe
`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:open zod audit advisory lockfile` returns 0 hits.
